snippet.title: Shadowstone | Steam Next Fest Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Overcome impossible odds and survive Steam Next Fest, October 19-26. Wishlist on Steam: https://dhvn.gg/sstone-steam

Unseen horrors and challenges await you in Shadowstone, an upcoming 1-4 player tactics roguelite from developer Secret Door and publisher Dreamhaven.

Survive a brutal world where monsters lurk in every corner, and victory is not guaranteed. Experiment with a wide array of heroes, whether you play solo or with a party of up to 3 other players: the Witch, Pyromancer, Berserker, Ranger, Rogue, and Assassin are all yours to learn and master. 

Upgrade spells to weave devastation on the board, create synergies with your party, and try to outlast the ever-changing labyrinth of different enemies and biomes in your quest to survive. 

Set in the world of Sunderfolk™, you must survive as the Lich’s experiments in a cruel, unforgiving environment. 

😈 Play the demo during Steam Next Fest (October 19-26)
▶️ Coming to Steam Early Access in 2026 

—

Wishlist on Steam: https://dhvn.gg/sstone-steam
Wishlist on Epic Games Store: https://dhvn.gg/sstone-epic

Join our Discord: discord.gg/secretdoor 
Follow us on socials: http://linktr.ee/dreamhavenent
